semiconductor_relevance: High — Chain Sun Technology Ltd. is actively involved in the semiconductor equipment sector, providing essential components and systems for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Chain Sun Technology Ltd. specializes in the development and supply of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and components, including parts for wafer handling and factory monitoring systems. Established in 2010, the company has expanded its capabilities to include smart manufacturing solutions and has installed equipment in various semiconductor fabs.
